given.note: Screen 3 (FS section 7: 'A mobile (required, D103) and an email if they have one; the way'; A4-82: 'How should Lee's Barbershop reach you about this visit, and at what number or email? Reply 1 Text me, 2 Calls only, 3 Texts, never calls, 4 Email'): calls only is not offered (Q-07), and no line check runs on the page (README default 54). Alex picks Text me and types his mobile, with no email. Nothing is written; nothing on file for the number is looked up for the answer, so it reads the same whether or not Rosie knows it (S13-45; README default 57). The mobile is an example in the 555-01xx range; the read-back's id is a placeholder.
